items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... And Marty Orr. And Marty Orr. [INTERVIEWEE] Was it?

ctx.x: Well, almost all those boys, those musicians who have, were calling that were really born out in Louisiana. And they'd come to New Orleans and build up into this, these names for themselves.
Yes, Punch was born, I think, in Raceland out there. Raceland. Raceland. And Marty Orr. And Marty Orr.
